panels.title: Payment Execution Rate by Result
panels.description: Payment throughput per second categorized by outcome (settled, held, rejected, failed). Query: sum(rate(flx_payments_total[5m])) by (result)

panels.title: Cumulative Settled Payments
panels.description: Total count of successfully settled transactions since process boot. Query: sum(flx_payments_total{result="settled"})

panels.title: Idempotency Tier Resolution
panels.description: Rate of idempotency evaluations by resolution tier (fastpath_replay, db_replay, conflict). Query: sum(rate(flx_idempotency_total[5m])) by (tier)

panels.title: Ledger Optimistic Concurrency Control Retries
panels.description: Frequency of OCC retries in ledger account balance updates. Query: rate(flx_ledger_occ_retries_total[5m])
